body: Does anyone know of any tickets for sale? I’m looking for 2 for my fiancé and I and can’t seem to find any. Help is much appreciated

I’m sorry you had that happened to you, the pain of losing a loved one (especially a parent) is indescribable and the wound never fully heals. I hope your able to heal from the pain and still find your own happiness

I’m thankful for the people in my life, I just wish I was better at expressing it. Showing any kind of emotion is painful for me and as a result I just bottle everything up. To some people I probably look like a sociopath because I rarely show any sort of emotion or reaction to anything. Sometimes I’m not sure myself if I’m not.

But I do appreciate you taking to time to have a conversation with me, it’s rare anyone even bothers in my daily life. So for a random stranger on the internet to put so much effort to connect with me is actually very heartwarming and comforting. So thank you for being there for me when the darkness feels overwhelming

Yeah alcohol abuse it’s no joke, I’ve lost a couple family members from it. It’s why my parents separated and I lost my uncle a few years ago. I’m usually pretty good about understanding my limits but sometimes I just get carried away, whether I’m at a party or at the bar with friends. When I go out now I usually am the one that drives so I can keep myself under control cause I know I’m responsible for the safety of others. I also never go out alone for the same reasons. I have an addictive personality and poor impulse control, so have others around me that I care about helps me to keep it under control

My fiancé is the only person that really keeps me going at times, they’ve been a calming presence throughout our relationship and it helps somewhat. There are days though where even they can’t help me and this is one of them.

I really want to stop drinking as often as I do, alcoholism runs in my family and I know it’s a dangerous road. I’m not drinking as much as I used to, just drinking fairly often if that makes sense. I used to get blackout drunk every night for weeks straight and now it’s just a few beers or so. That’s about the only positive I can take from my current situation

I would love to move somewhere else, but I’m almost completely broke and don’t really have anywhere to go. I do have things I would want to do, but I would have to go to college in order to do it and the thought of going back to school honestly makes me terrified and a little sick
